items.title: Will a local traffic-calming & safe-streets measure pass in this community?
items.content_html: A community-driven speculative outcome bounty: if the proposed local traffic-calming measure passes and is verified, funds are directed to a designated community safe-streets or accessibility foundation chosen by the proposal sponsors. Honest-zero until real stakes; resolution and recipients must be publicly verified before any disbursement.

_polytab.plainSummary:
What is the question: Will a local traffic-calming measure pass?
If it passes (verified): Funds go to a designated safe-streets/accessibility foundation for the affected community.
Proof: Official public results and verified recipient designation. Honest-zero: $0 funded, 0 votes until real on-chain stakes.
